cam2026_001.text: Divina studies how climate displacement affects girls’ education in Kenya and hopes to develop a social-impact venture.

cam2026_002.text: Mabel brings community-development experience and aims to strengthen locally led conservation in Africa.

cam2026_003.text: Joseph has worked on vaccination initiatives and is developing expertise in population health and health data.

cam2026_004.text: Emmanuel’s research experience spans climate adaptation and environmental sustainability. He aims to strengthen climate resilience.

cam2026_005.text: Daphne has worked on locally designed innovations and studies engineering for sustainable development.

cam2026_006.text: Privintiva brings wildlife-conservancy and governance experience to her conservation leadership studies.

cam2026_007.text: Alice’s work focuses on sustainable construction, low-carbon materials and circular approaches to infrastructure.

ubc2026_032.text: Analem combines environmental science and GIS experience. Youth Climate Council Ghana publicly introduced him as its Western Region focal person.
